response.original_title: Agatha Christie Poirot After the Funeral
response.overview: Richard Abernathie, head of the dysfunctional Abernethie clan, died a natural death or so his family believes. But his sister, Cora, drops a bombshell she believes Richard was murdered.  Poirot is summoned to look into Cora's charges, but his investigation is interrupted by yet another bombshell-Cora is herself brutally murdered, leaving Poirot with two murder cases on his hands.  Co-starring Geraldine James (Gandhi, and Robert Bathurst (The Wind in the Willows), AFTER THE FUNERAL brilliantly evokes the mysteries between innocence and guilt as only Agatha Christie could have imagined.
response.title: Agatha Christie Poirot After the Funeral
